boarding_points.name: Terminal da Ponta da Espera
boarding_points.operator: EMAP (terminal); Serviporto / Internacional Marítima / Henvil / Banav (vessels)
boarding_points.notes: São Luís side of the vehicle-ferry crossing to Cujupe; 12 scheduled round trips/day (up to 20 on holidays); record year 1.8M pax + 371.5k vehicles (2017); Carnival 2026: 71,737 pax in 11 days.
boarding_points.source: OSM ferry_terminal node cross-checked with EMAP/Porto do Itaqui press pages (https://www.portodoitaqui.com.br/imprensa/noticia/recorde-historico-nos-terminais-de-ferryboat)

boarding_points.name: Terminal do Cujupe
boarding_points.operator: EMAP (terminal); Serviporto / Internacional Marítima / Henvil / Banav (vessels)
boarding_points.notes: Mainland (Baixada Maranhense) side of the vehicle-ferry crossing; road gateway to ~35 municipalities / ~2.5M residents; BR-308 connection.
boarding_points.source: OSM ferry_terminal way cross-checked with Nominatim ('Terminal do Cujupe, BR-308, Alcântara') and EMAP pages

boarding_points.name: Cais da Praia Grande — Terminal Hidroviário de São Luís (Rampa Campos Melo)
boarding_points.linked_locale: São Luís (Centro Histórico / Praia Grande, UNESCO)
boarding_points.operator: Municipal/state quay; lancha & catamaran operators incl. Lancha Bahia Star
boarding_points.notes: Historic-center quay for the passenger lancha/catamaran crossing to Alcântara (R$20/leg, 1h15–1h45); departures tide-dependent — quay area dries at low water on ~7 m springs.
boarding_points.source: OSM ferry_terminal 'Cais da Praia Grande - Terminal Hidroviário de São Luís'; turismosaoluis.com.br/a-cidade/informacoes-uteis/; viajenaviagem.com/destino/sao-luis/alcantara/

boarding_points.name: Terminal Hidroviário de Alcântara (Porto do Jacaré)
boarding_points.notes: Alcântara town's passenger pier below the Ladeira do Jacaré; adjacent 'Cais de Alcântara' pier at -2.40598,-44.42418; gateway to the colonial center and (by road) the Centro Espacial de Alcântara.
boarding_points.source: OSM ferry_terminal 'Sao Luis - Alcantara' + pier 'Cais de Alcântara'; pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Travessia_São_Luís–Alcântara (Porto de Jacaré–Terminal Hidroviário de Alcântara)

boarding_points.name: Espigão Costeiro da Ponta d'Areia (planned pier)
boarding_points.notes: State project ('Trapiche da Ponta d'Areia') for a deeper-water boarding pier to free Alcântara departures from the tide constraint at Praia Grande. Coordinates are the existing Espigão Costeiro breakwater/promenade (OSM); exact berth position TBD.
boarding_points.source: OSM 'Espigão Costeiro, Ciclovia do Espigão, Ponta D'Areia'; OAB-MA project note cited in pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Travessia_São_Luís–Alcântara

boarding_points.name: Marina Ilha Boat (Ponta d'Areia)
boarding_points.notes: Leisure-craft marina inside the Ponta d'Areia lagoon mouth; charter/day-boat base and charging-pedestal candidate for the bay spider.

boarding_points.name: Iate Clube de São Luís
boarding_points.linked_locale: São Luís (Ponta d'Areia, Av. Dr. Jackson Kepler Lago)
boarding_points.notes: The capital's yacht club on the Ponta d'Areia waterfront; premium charter anchor for bay and Alcântara runs.
boarding_points.source: OSM/Nominatim 'Iate Clube, Avenida Doutor Jackson Kepler Lago, Ponta D'Areia'

boarding_points.name: Cais de São José de Ribamar
boarding_points.linked_locale: São José de Ribamar (east side of the island, Baía de São José)
boarding_points.notes: Pilgrimage-town pier on the island's east coast; local boats cross the Baía de São José toward Icatu; node for the planned Lençóis Maranhenses gateway corridor.
boarding_points.source: OSM man_made=pier 'Cais de São José de Ribamar'; EMAP documents list 'cais de São José de Ribamar' among state passenger facilities

boarding_points.name: Icatu waterfront (proposed ferry terminal)
boarding_points.linked_locale: Icatu (mainland east of the Baía de São José)
boarding_points.notes: A state project would run a São Luís–Icatu ferry to cut travel time to Barreirinhas / Lençóis Maranhenses. No verified pier coordinate exists — Icatu town admin center sits at approx -2.7752,-44.0644 (Nominatim), but the terminal site is unconfirmed, so coordinates are left null rather than guessed.
